answer: A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The atlas counter is kept in crystal and shale shows each reset. An hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2143 identities would post 3819 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
